set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 1. Add primitive-backed axis-safe indices and domain identities, ResponseSchema with neutral geometry/topology references, ResolvedResponseSelection, a non-generic row-major Double ResponseBlock that owns its primitive buffer directly, ReadResult, provenance and receipts, ResponseSource planning/execution, typed PlannedRead composition, and axis-keyed locality capabilities with receipt conformance. Adapt current ResponseBlockSource and DatasetBackend without moving latent or archive logic. Acceptance: in-memory and NIfTI values remain unchanged; order, shape, duplicate, and wrong-domain laws pass; index arrays stay primitive on JVM/Scala.js; no public mutable buffer or ownership-preserving copy exists; adapters copy unless ownership transfers; current public duplicate rejection remains; JVM and JS gates pass. Stop if response must import image, surface, graph, archive, dataset hierarchy, or concrete representations.
